h1: Curious About Your Risk for Heart Disease, Stroke, or Cancer?

blocks.text: Victory Medical Offers Comprehensive Head-To-Toe Health Exams

blocks.html: Have you been curious about your health, but only relied on annual physical exams that do not provide much detail? Victory Medical offers a head-to-toe health exam called Heartwise that helps take the guesswork out of your health. This special exam is more thorough than a standard physical exam as it provides a 360-degree view of an individual’s health. The Heartwise exam can capture issues that a traditional physical exam often misses. It also can help provide answers to underlying conditions that one may not realize they have.

blocks.text: Have You Ever Wondered About Common Health Issues You Currently Struggle With?

blocks.html: Some people experience fatigue, headaches, sleep problems and even swelling in their legs without ever knowing the cause or receiving a proper diagnosis. The Heartwise exam that Victory Medical provides can help get to the bottom of these issues as well as other symptoms  in order to arm you with the knowledge to help prevent future health risks. This allows you to understand the root cause of issues versus just treating symptoms. Through the Heartwise exam provided by Victory Medical, we can help analyze your risk for heart disease, stroke, and cancer to get a true picture of your health.

blocks.text: What Should I Expect During the Heartwise Exam Provided By Victory Medical?

blocks.html: The experience is non-invasive and pain-free. The process takes about 90 minutes for a full head-to-to patient assessment. After the initial assessment, the patient will follow-up in 4-6 weeks at which time they will receive a folder containing a comprehensive set of personalized results. During this follow-up visit, they will review all results with their provider and create a plan of action to address any conditions that were identified during the exam.

blocks.text: What Makes This Physical Exam Different Than Others I Have Had Previously?

blocks.html: The Heartwise exam provided by Victory Medical uses a unique proprietary algorithm that was developed through extensive research at Harvard and analyzes your real time data and compares it to decades of data.

blocks.text: Will My Insurance Pay For the Heartwise Exam Provided By Victory Medical?

blocks.html: Most patients who schedule the Heartwise exam with Victory Medical and utilize their insurance will pay little or no money out of pocket. It is important to schedule your appointment ahead of time with Victory Medical so we can ensure that your insurance benefits will be verified and we can provide you a better idea of how your insurance will cover the exam.
